home.heroSub: You just don't know how to get there.
home.problemText: Designers waiting on dev queues. Salespeople patching things together in Excel. Teachers working around software limits. Business owners doing by hand what should run itself. AI means the thing that wasn't in your hands — finally is.
home.solutionDesc: I have the AI. You have the need. I don't build for you — I build with you. What gets made is yours.
home.step1Desc: You know what you want. You just don't know how to get there.

home.step3Desc: Built right, it'll serve you long-term. Stuck again? Come back.

about.title: About
about.intro: Software engineer for close to 20 years. This year I left the office to find out: what can one person actually build, with AI as a co-developer?
about.story1: I've seen too many projects with million-dollar budgets deliver nothing but surface polish. Our small team, without AI, would ship the same thing in six months to a year.
about.story2: With AI, the gap is even wider. Ask the right questions, point it in the right direction, and a complete product — backend, admin panel, payment integration — comes together in a day or two. AI.Did was built exactly that way.
about.philosophyTitle: AI is the tool. The thinking is the value.
about.philosophy1: AI isn't magic. It's a highly capable engineer with no long-term memory — give it no direction and it'll build you a skyscraper to house a dog. That direction comes from experience. Close to 20 years of it, for me.
about.philosophy2: What I want to do: be the guide for people who have an idea but don't know where to start. Many people will build only one product in their lifetime. The first one is hard. And it matters.
about.connect: If there's something you've been turning over in your mind — or you just want to talk — reach out.

demos.title: Demos
demos.subtitle: Things actually running in production, not just side projects.
demos.intro: These are things that actually run. Not built to show off — built because someone uses them.

projects.name: Marsen.AI.Did
projects.description: "Can one person build a complete commercial product?" — that question drove AI.Did into existence. Built with AI as a co-developer from scratch: a multi-theme storefront with full checkout flow, an admin panel for products, orders, and members, and a real payment integration with TapPay. Clean Architecture underneath so every layer is replaceable. Not built to sell — built to prove a point.

projects.name: Becca.Surf.App
projects.description: Surf instructor Becca didn't need a complex system — she needed something that made you want to paddle out the moment you saw it. A single-page front with lesson packages, teaching videos, and overseas trip listings. An admin panel she can update herself without calling a developer. Simple, and exactly enough.

projects.name: Amy.Clam.Site
projects.description: An e-commerce MVP for a small-farm clam brand — their first digital storefront. Deep LINE integration via LIFF: users browse, order, and receive notifications entirely inside LINE, no extra app needed. Lightweight storefront, self-serve admin, built so the owner can run it independently without a developer on call.

igToken.title: IG Token Generator
igToken.helpIntro: You'll need an Instagram App on Meta for Developers. Here's how:
igToken.helpStep2: Create (or select) an App — type: Business
igToken.helpStep3: Add Instagram Graph API from the products list
igToken.helpStep4: Under Settings → Basic, copy your App ID and App Secret
igToken.helpStep5: Add this tool's callback URL to your App's Valid OAuth Redirect URIs
igToken.helpNote: Your App Secret is used server-side only to exchange the token — never logged or stored.
igToken.subtitle: Enter your App ID and App Secret to kick off OAuth and get a long-lived token (valid ~60 days).
igToken.successNote: Valid for ~{days} days. Keep it safe.
igToken.errNoCode: Instagram didn't return an authorization code
igToken.errTokenFailed: Token exchange failed — double-check your App ID and Secret
igToken.errLongTokenFailed: Failed to get a long-lived token
